# Security policy

LienCAM is a hobby project of one person and its contributors. It is not a company product and there is no paid
support.

## Reporting a security problem

Please report it privately, not in a public issue or discussion.

1. Open this repository's **Security** tab.
2. Choose **Report a vulnerability**. This opens a private advisory form that only the maintainers can read.

## What to include

- The LienCAM version and your operating system.
- What you did, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any file or setting needed to reproduce it. Please do not attach secrets or private data.
- Whether it could make a machine move unexpectedly. If a machine is moving wrongly, press your E-STOP first.

## What to expect

Replies are best effort. There is no promised response time and no promised fix date. Reports are read, checked
and fixed as time allows, and you will be told when a fix is released.
